next.reason: 1985: with PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE 'the program collating sequence is the collating sequence associated with alphabet-name-1'. §2023:12.3.6.4 GR9: 'the initial alphanumeric program collating sequence is the collating sequence associated with alphabet-name-1', effective from the initial state per §2023:12.3.6.4 GR12. 'Initial' matters only when a SET statement changes the sequence, and alphabet-name-2/NATIONAL are new syntax; a 1985 program gets the same sequence throughout.
